post.caption:
The deepest hole we have ever drilled reached 12 km. The centre of the Earth is 6,371 km down. Below the drill sits the mantle, which is not lava but solid rock that flows at about the speed your fingernails grow. Shrink the planet to an apple and the crust is thinner than the peel.
